{{Top|leg}}
'''Infrared bafflers''' masked the minor heat emissions from an [[R-TechApp Man Trap]]. As many [[Species/Legends|species]] were capable of seeing into the [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] spectrum, infrared bafflers were used to help camouflage the [[Reversed repulsorfield|man trap]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
